zen.b1: Maintain a production Flutter application serving Malaysian taxpayers across Android, iOS, and Huawei AppGallery ecosystems.
zen.b2: Investigate platform-specific issues across iOS, Android, and the Huawei AppGallery build, which runs in the HMS environment without Google Mobile Services.
zen.b3: Handle mobile-side localization across English and Bahasa Malaysia, aligning with shared string conventions used by the web platform.
zen.b4: Collaborate with backend teams on REST API integration and data consistency across releases.

bestinet.b1: Built a mobile TOTP authenticator app in Flutter to harden enterprise login security with time-based one-time tokens.
bestinet.b2: Optimized authentication latency through API call restructuring and response caching, reducing login time by 40% and lifting user satisfaction by 25%.
bestinet.b3: Designed secure user flows and token storage to keep TOTP secrets safe across app sessions.
bestinet.b4: Collaborated with backend engineers on robust, scalable REST API integration.

projects.intro: Here are a few projects I've worked on recently.
projects.emptyDesc: No projects in this category yet. Stay tuned!
projects.baglock_desc: This project implements an anti-theft system using a fingerprint scanner, GPS module, and GSM module to protect a bag or backpack. The system allows authorized users to unlock the bag using their fingerprints while sending GPS coordinates to a predefined number in case of unauthorized access.
projects.movie_desc: The Movie Ticket Booking System is a web-based application that facilitates easy and convenient booking, cancellation, and management of movie tickets. With separate user and admin interfaces, the system offers a streamlined experience for both users and administrators.
projects.bookstore_desc: This web application allows customers to explore a variety of books, create accounts, make purchases, and view their purchase history. Sellers have the ability to manage the book inventory and access pickup details for completed orders. The system provides a seamless way for customers to discover and acquire their favorite books, while empowering sellers with the tools to efficiently manage their book offerings.
